_doc: Alert-name -> Grafana panel coordinates (DEMO-8 / #60). Loaded by agents.auto_ticketing on every ticket-create attempt; failure to render or attach the panel must NOT break ticket creation. Keys are Prometheus alert rule names (the `alert` field from demo/scenarios/*.yaml). Add entries here when wiring a new scenario whose Grafana view is worth attaching. `dashboard_uid` is the stable id from the dashboard's URL (.../d/<UID>/...); `panel_id` is the numeric id shown when 'Inspect → Panel JSON' on that panel. `from` and `to` accept Grafana's relative time expressions.
